meaning: Conditional research-work priority, not treatment ranking or probability of truth

rows.anchor_replication: Rare-variant association plus model perturbation; variant phenotypes differ and adult rescue is unproved. The 2026 gene map is not independent replication of reused samples.
rows.falsifier: Engaged correction after maturation fails to restore a prespecified network phenotype across variants.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B: prioritize as a precision-model arm only with independent isogenic/variant replication and a laboratory. No patient gene editing.

rows.anchor_replication: Rare, pleiotropic CNV associations; deletion and duplication are not the same perturbation or established shared endotype.
rows.falsifier: Separate classes fail to converge beyond non-TS developmental controls.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B: aggregate evidence mapping feasible; model access and qualified laboratory missing. No broad synaptic treatment inference.

rows.anchor_replication: GWAS locus association; effector gene, tissue and direction unresolved; summary statistics are not verified acquired.
rows.falsifier: Fine-mapped regulatory evidence favors another gene or validated perturbation misses the nominated phenotype.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B conditional on lawful summary statistics and ancestry-matched reference inputs; no broad NR2F1 manipulation.

rows.anchor_replication: Genetic/model support does not prove selective mature rescue; broad chromatin effects complicate specificity.
rows.falsifier: Selective engaged module correction fails, or only early global correction works.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: C for intervention investment; B only for qualified mechanistic replication. Broad epigenetic intervention deferred.

rows.anchor_replication: Rare etiologic human/model anchor, not general histamine deficiency; the October pilot pools diagnoses and cannot validate a TS selector.
rows.falsifier: Neural signature fails independent replication or response is nonspecific motor suppression.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B rare-mechanism research, C general-population translation. No peripheral-histamine diagnostic or supplement inference.

rows.anchor_replication: CELSR3 model perturbation is a causal preclinical lead, not human target validation; global antagonism combines compartments.
rows.falsifier: Cell-restricted normalization fails while nonspecific motor suppression changes behavior.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B paired with H01; independent human-variant model and normal-movement controls required. No drug-selection claim.

rows.anchor_replication: Randomized on-treatment D1 benefit anchors the idea; responder withdrawal is maintenance, small adult evidence uncertain. Durable synergy itself untested.
rows.falsifier: Informative factorial interaction and post-exposure contrast exclude worthwhile added durability.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: A for existing trial outcome/estimand synthesis; B for future regulated trial. No withdrawal experiment here.

rows.anchor_replication: Small severe-adult postmortem association cannot separate cell number/state or cause/consequence.
rows.falsifier: Restored selective timing leaves abnormal release unchanged, or only suppresses ordinary movement.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B mechanistic replication; no current open validated human assay or lab. Cell transplantation not justified.

rows.anchor_replication: Model ablation supports plausibility; human VAChT PET null challenges universal terminal loss. Timing is a distinct unproved claim, not a null-evasion device.
rows.falsifier: Timing-matched intervention fails against activity-matched control with engagement.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B conditional laboratory work; no global cholinergic enhancement inference.

rows.anchor_replication: Six-versus-six postmortem association, no established upstream causality; donor and tissue confounding remain.
rows.falsifier: Temporal cell-swap/correction shows neuronal defect independent of microglial state.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: C: replication and causal direction first; no immune-treatment escalation.

rows.anchor_replication: Transcription is not respiration; compensation, treatment and tissue effects remain viable explanations.
rows.falsifier: Verified metabolic normalization leaves dysfunction unchanged or worsens it.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: C: living-model functional replication first; no supplement or dietary recommendation.

rows.anchor_replication: Human MRS association, age-study disagreement, no replicated treatment-selector interaction.
rows.falsifier: Reliable externally tested marker adds no predictive treatment interaction beyond clinical baseline.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B design only; longitudinal compatible data missing. Bulk GABA is not synaptic inhibition or a treatment direction.

rows.anchor_replication: Small targeted-tic pilot versus negative generic glutamatergic trials; no demonstrated global durable generalization.
rows.falsifier: Adequate engaged learning change fails to generalize or persist.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B conditional confirmatory design; A only for existing outcome mapping. No off-label intervention.

rows.anchor_replication: Small positive crossover, larger inconclusive CANNA-TICS primary endpoint and negative MAGL trial; no independent selector. Weekly direct-function audit does not establish superiority.
rows.falsifier: Prespecified biomarker fails replicated interaction with informative precision.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: C target escalation; A for resolving existing function/harms evidence. No post hoc subgroup promoted or cannabis advice.

rows.anchor_replication: Severe-adult connectivity associations and convergent cohorts are useful; not randomized superiority of targeting. Negative SMA trial retained.
rows.falsifier: Group-map specificity fails spatial nulls, or an informative randomized comparison excludes worthwhile superiority despite verified engagement.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B: one bounded group-only map/code/license gate before free-compute replication. No individual scans or stimulation.

rows.anchor_replication: Small refractory-adult feasibility cohorts, overlapping reports, state/recall mismatches; functional superiority unproved.
rows.falsifier: Held-out decoding fails or no worthwhile exposure-adjusted benefit over optimized continuous DBS.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B for aggregate methodology, C new execution without specialist center. No surgery or device changes.

rows.anchor_replication: Short-term controlled benefit retained; rhythm-versus-arrhythmia contrast challenges rhythm necessity, follow-up attrition limits durability.
rows.falsifier: Sensation-matched control and engagement comparison fail the specific mechanism.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: A existing trial interpretation; B independent governed mechanistic replication. No device construction or self-stimulation.

rows.anchor_replication: Pediatric/adult randomized symptomatic benefit is established anchor; returnee maintenance and functional contrasts do not validate model-guided matching.
rows.falsifier: Identifiable parameters fail to improve outcomes over equal-intensity standard care out of sample.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: A patient-centered evidence synthesis; B prospective matching evaluation. No inference that persistent tics reflect inadequate effort.

rows.anchor_replication: Longitudinal associations and ascertainment discordance, not causal protection or universal remission. Adult severe persistence explicitly retained.
rows.falsifier: Marker fails external prospective value or targeted functional perturbation fails.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B only with suitable longitudinal access; generic cohort search already closed. Do not substitute childhood improvement for adult need.

rows.anchor_replication: Few-donor organoids support developmental mechanism exploration, not mature therapeutic reversibility.
rows.falsifier: Blinded independent donor replication or late rescue fails.
rows.priority_feasibility_safety: B for mechanism, C clinical translation. Broad developmental manipulation deferred.
